## Order health check (hourly)
Flags orders on integrated channels (Shopify, Amazon, Faire, TikTok) older than `graceMinutes` that are draft / quotation / failed, confirmed with no shipment, or carry an open exception. Emails only NEW problems (static data remembers what was sent). Auto-fix (Ben 28-Oct-26): Amazon orders failed with 'Order total mismatch' where Fulfil left out Amazon's tax are retried via Retry Order Import (guarded sub-workflow, max `maxRetries`), then dropped from the email once imported. Only write: retry_order_import.

Built by Claude for Ben 23-Oct-26. Starts on SANDBOX. To go live: Settings tenant/baseUrl = PROD and switch the 3 read nodes to the Fulfil PROD credential.
